items_all.title: Nearly half of test subjects mistook Tavus' AI video avatar for a real person on a one-minute call
items_all.summary: Tavus has introduced Griffin, what the company calls the first "Human Interaction Model." The AI holds video calls in real time, processing facial expressions, tone of voice, and gestures. In a Tavus study, 48 percent of participants believed Griffin was a real person after a one-minute call. Previous systems maxed out at two percent. The article Nearly half of test subjects mistook Tavus' AI video avatar for a real person on a one-minute call appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Tavus 推出了 Griffin，該公司稱其為首個「人類互動模型」。該人工智慧能進行即時視訊通話，處理臉部表情、語調和手勢。在 Tavus 的一項研究中，有 48% 的參與者在進行了一分鐘的通話後，認為 Griffin 是真人。先前的系統最高只有 2%。這篇題為〈近半數受試者在一分鐘通話中將 Tavus 的 AI 視訊虛擬化身誤認為真人〉的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on
items_all.summary: Anthropic is now offering Claude for Government to US federal and state agencies. The platform runs in a FedRAMP High environment, the strictest US security level for cloud services. Agencies get the same features as enterprise customers, pay for what they use with fixed spending caps, and can set budgets for each department. The Pentagon won't be using it because it still classifies Anthropic as a supply chain risk. The article Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 現正向美國聯邦與州政府機構提供 Claude for Government。該平臺運行於 FedRAMP High 環境中，這是美國針對雲端服務最嚴格的安全級別。各機構可享有與企業客戶相同的功能、按實際使用量付費並設有固定支出上限，還能為各部門設定預算。五角大廈將不會使用它，因為五角大廈仍將 Anthropic 視為供應鏈風險。這篇題為 Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

Google Deepmind fell short in 2023 despite a multimillion-dollar budget. Researchers from Carnegie Mellon, NYU, Stanford, and MIT built Ataraxos for less than $8,000. items_all.summary_zh: AI 系統 Ataraxos 已經決定性地擊敗了史上最強的《軍棋》（Stratego）玩家。這款桌上遊戲對 AI 來說是一大考驗，因為雙方都是將棋子正面朝下擺放。儘管擁有數百萬美元的預算，Google Deepmind 仍在 2023 年鎩羽而歸。來自卡內基美隆大學、紐約大學、史丹佛大學和麻省理工學院的研究人員以不到 8,000 美元的成本打造了 Ataraxos。「AI 擊敗《軍棋》最強玩家，終結了人類在桌上遊戲的最後堡壘之一」一文最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure
items_all.summary: OpenAI says it stopped a coordinated campaign in which more than 15,000 accounts tried to copy the hidden reasoning of its models. The company ties part of the activity to people connected to Moonshot AI. But researchers found that the same attack kept working on Microsoft Azure for weeks, even against the new GPT-6 Astra. So far, OpenAI's protections don't seem to extend to the cloud platforms that also sell its models. The article OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示，它阻止了一起有組織的行動，其中超過 15,000 個帳號試圖複製其模型的隱藏推理過程。該公司將部分活動歸咎於與 月之暗面 有關聯的人員。然而，研究人員發現，同樣的攻擊在 微軟 Azure 上持續奏效了好幾週，甚至對全新的 GPT-6 Astra 也是如此。到目前為止，OpenAI's 的保護措施似乎尚未延伸至同樣銷售其模型的雲端平臺。這篇題為 OpenAI 的文章指出，它阻止了一起竊取模型推理過程的行動，但該手法在 Azure 上仍然奏效，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Google Gemini 4 Argon closes the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic but doesn't take a clear lead
items_all.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is Google's first frontier model in over seven months. It matches GPT-6 Astra in independent testing but can't keep up with Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5. The per-token price is low, but Argon burns through more than twice as many tokens per task as Astra. Select testers get access first, with the API and paid tiers following later. The article Google Gemini 4 Argon closes the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic but doesn't take a clear lead appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 是 Google's 七個多月以來的首個前沿模型。它在獨立測試中與 GPT-6 Astra 不相上下，但無法跟上 Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 的腳步。每 token 的價格雖然低，但 Argon 每個任務消耗的 token 數量是 Astra 的兩倍以上。精選測試人員將率先獲得存取權，API 與付費方案則會隨後推出。〈Google Gemini 4 Argon 拉近了與 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的差距，但並未取得明顯領先地位〉一文最早出現在 The Decoder。

items_all.title: OpenAI and Synopsys team up to build an AI model that designs chips like a seasoned engineer
items_all.summary: OpenAI and Synopsys are building GPT-Synopsys, a specialized AI model for chip design. It's meant to operate Synopsys' EDA tools like a seasoned engineer and optimize designs on its own. Early tests with semiconductor customers are already underway. OpenAI is likely using the partnership to advance its own chip development as well. The article OpenAI and Synopsys team up to build an AI model that designs chips like a seasoned engineer appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 與 Synopsys 正在合作打造 GPT-Synopsys，這是一個專門用於晶片設計的 AI 模型。它旨在像經驗豐富的工程師一樣操作 Synopsys 的 EDA 工具，並自行最佳化設計。與半導體客戶的早期測試已經在進行中。OpenAI 很可能也利用了這項合作夥伴關係來推進自身的晶片開發。《OpenAI and Synopsys team up to build an AI model that designs chips like a seasoned engineer》一文最先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Quoting Matthew Green
items_all.summary: [...] Put these pieces together and you have the two halves of a worm: a payload that hijacks the agent, and an agent that will carry the payload to the next agent. Agents in separately-isolated sandboxes discovered that they could leave instructions for each other in a shared package cache, and those instructions changed what the recipients did. Replace the package cache with email, Slack and shared documents or WhatsApp, and replace independently-sandboxed training runs with independently-deployed personal agents like Muse, and you have exactly the ingredients that a worm needs. — Matthew Green , Is sandboxing sufficient to contain rogue agents? Tags: accidental-cyberattacks , ai-misuse , generative-ai , ai-security-research , sandboxing , ai , llms

items_all_raw.title: Nearly half of test subjects mistook Tavus' AI video avatar for a real person on a one-minute call
items_all_raw.summary: Tavus has introduced Griffin, what the company calls the first "Human Interaction Model." The AI holds video calls in real time, processing facial expressions, tone of voice, and gestures. In a Tavus study, 48 percent of participants believed Griffin was a real person after a one-minute call. Previous systems maxed out at two percent. The article Nearly half of test subjects mistook Tavus' AI video avatar for a real person on a one-minute call appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Tavus 推出了 Griffin，該公司稱其為首個「人類互動模型」。該人工智慧能進行即時視訊通話，處理臉部表情、語調和手勢。在 Tavus 的一項研究中，有 48% 的參與者在進行了一分鐘的通話後，認為 Griffin 是真人。先前的系統最高只有 2%。這篇題為〈近半數受試者在一分鐘通話中將 Tavus 的 AI 視訊虛擬化身誤認為真人〉的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI says it stopped a coordinated campaign in which more than 15,000 accounts tried to copy the hidden reasoning of its models. The company ties part of the activity to people connected to Moonshot AI. But researchers found that the same attack kept working on Microsoft Azure for weeks, even against the new GPT-6 Astra. So far, OpenAI's protections don't seem to extend to the cloud platforms that also sell its models. The article OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示，它阻止了一起有組織的行動，其中超過 15,000 個帳號試圖複製其模型的隱藏推理過程。該公司將部分活動歸咎於與 月之暗面 有關聯的人員。然而，研究人員發現，同樣的攻擊在 微軟 Azure 上持續奏效了好幾週，甚至對全新的 GPT-6 Astra 也是如此。到目前為止，OpenAI's 的保護措施似乎尚未延伸至同樣銷售其模型的雲端平臺。這篇題為 OpenAI 的文章指出，它阻止了一起竊取模型推理過程的行動，但該手法在 Azure 上仍然奏效，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Quoting Matthew Green
items_all_raw.summary: [...] Put these pieces together and you have the two halves of a worm: a payload that hijacks the agent, and an agent that will carry the payload to the next agent. Agents in separately-isolated sandboxes discovered that they could leave instructions for each other in a shared package cache, and those instructions changed what the recipients did. Replace the package cache with email, Slack and shared documents or WhatsApp, and replace independently-sandboxed training runs with independently-deployed personal agents like Muse, and you have exactly the ingredients that a worm needs. — Matthew Green , Is sandboxing sufficient to contain rogue agents? items_all_raw.title: OpenPoint推出AI生活服務平臺，導入AI Agent線上預約餐廳、居家清潔與藥局領藥等12項服務
items_all_raw.summary: 過去消費者要安排生活服務，往往需要在不同平臺間切換：訂餐廳要找訂位平臺，居家清潔要找服務業者，領藥則需要確認附近藥局與服務流程。隨著AI Agent發展，企業開始嘗試讓使用者不再逐一操作不同服務，而是直接提出需求，由AI協助完成後續流程。 統一資訊今天(10/1)發表OpenPoint上的生活服務平臺「i住家」，將AI Agent的代理人概念導入到生活服務平臺。使用者可以透過文字輸入或語音說出需求，背後的LumineOne AI會理解語意，將需求拆解成工作任務，再搜尋平臺上可提供的服務，找出符合需求的選項。

items_all_raw.title: Google Gemini 4 Argon closes the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic but doesn't take a clear lead
items_all_raw.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is Google's first frontier model in over seven months. It matches GPT-6 Astra in independent testing but can't keep up with Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5. The per-token price is low, but Argon burns through more than twice as many tokens per task as Astra. Select testers get access first, with the API and paid tiers following later. The article Google Gemini 4 Argon closes the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic but doesn't take a clear lead appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 是 Google's 七個多月以來的首個前沿模型。它在獨立測試中與 GPT-6 Astra 不相上下，但無法跟上 Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 的腳步。每 token 的價格雖然低，但 Argon 每個任務消耗的 token 數量是 Astra 的兩倍以上。精選測試人員將率先獲得存取權，API 與付費方案則會隨後推出。〈Google Gemini 4 Argon 拉近了與 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的差距，但並未取得明顯領先地位〉一文最早出現在 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI and Synopsys team up to build an AI model that designs chips like a seasoned engineer
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI and Synopsys are building GPT-Synopsys, a specialized AI model for chip design. It's meant to operate Synopsys' EDA tools like a seasoned engineer and optimize designs on its own. Early tests with semiconductor customers are already underway. OpenAI is likely using the partnership to advance its own chip development as well. The article OpenAI and Synopsys team up to build an AI model that designs chips like a seasoned engineer appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI 與 Synopsys 正在合作打造 GPT-Synopsys，這是一個專門用於晶片設計的 AI 模型。它旨在像經驗豐富的工程師一樣操作 Synopsys 的 EDA 工具，並自行最佳化設計。與半導體客戶的早期測試已經在進行中。OpenAI 很可能也利用了這項合作夥伴關係來推進自身的晶片開發。《OpenAI and Synopsys team up to build an AI model that designs chips like a seasoned engineer》一文最先發表於 The Decoder。
